name: Ravenous Wolf
subtitle: so...chicken again?
rules: COVERT -- You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic. If you do, destroy a card named "Deception" you control or destroy this card.
notes: Catalog models COVERT as COVERT + TACTICAL + an enters-play trigger 'if you deployed it during an opponent's turn'; the card says you may play it whenever you could play a tactic, and 'if you do' destroy a Deception or this card. Timing condition differs.

notes: Catalog says 'an opponent's discard pile'; card says 'your opponent's discard pile'.

name: Vander Malagut
subtitle: seething hatred, seductive wit
rules: UNIQUE EVONDAN -- All your other "sarcophyle" characters gain 1 speed. -- If a character would be destroyed during a turn when this card damaged it, take control of that character instead. Treat that character as though it has received no damage this turn. It becomes a "sarcophyle". -- If this card is destroyed, destroy all other "sarcophyle" characters.
notes: Catalog: 'Reduce the amount of damage already inflicted to it this turn to 0' vs card 'Treat that character as though it has received no damage this turn'; 'When this card is destroyed' vs 'If'.
